reports.title: Flex LNG Ltd. ("we", "us", "our", "Flex LNG", or the “Company”) today announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

desk.headline: Revenue up 14% to $97.4m and adjusted EPS of $0.65 beat estimates; 2026 guidance kept, but now seen at mid-to-lower end

other.label: TCE rate
other.change: vs $70,921 a year ago; $86,119 in Q2

results: Revenue rose 14% from a year ago to $97.4m, a record third quarter, but fell from $106.8m in Q2 as spot earnings on Flex Volunteer dropped.
Adjusted profit was $35.0m ($0.65 a share) against $23.5m ($0.43) a year ago; GAAP profit of $42.8m was lifted by $10.2m of interest-rate swap gains.
Average earnings per ship were $78,875 a day, up from $70,921 a year ago; running costs were about $16,300 a day.
Flex LNG declared another $0.75 dividend (about $41m), its 21st in a row at that level, payable around 10 Dec.
It cut the margin on the Flex Artemis/Flex Amber lease and agreed a $145.5m sale and leaseback of Flex Enterprise, expected to free about $34m in Q4.

guidance.summary: On the call, Flex LNG kept its full-year 2026 ranges but said results will likely come in at the mid-to-lower end because the spot market is weak. It raised its running-cost guide to $16,200 a day from $16,000.

points: Management said the spot market is soft and the usual winter rise in rates has not fully arrived yet.
About 290 new ships are on order (roughly 35% of the fleet), so deliveries weigh on the near-term outlook.
Flex Volunteer stays in the spot market into Q1; Flex Artemis is still looking for work; Flex Ranger returns in Q1.
Firm backlog slipped to 48 years from 51 in Q2, and management moved its backlog and market signals to 'orange'.
There is no dividend guidance; each payout is decided quarterly, with the next decision at Q4 results in February.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and call coverage: Earnings Whispers call transcript and article (via Finviz), 11 Nov 2026

watch: Whether full-year 2026 results land at the lower end of the $345–370m revenue range.
New long-term charters for Flex Artemis, Flex Volunteer and Flex Ranger, and the Flex Freedom extension option.
Whether the $0.75 quarterly dividend is held in February, given the weaker backlog.
